Just because you have an AI verification pose, doesn't mean you can still bypass a "face ban". 

Bumble says "To investigate and block Users for reported infringements of our Terms and Conditions of Use" they will take "Name and user registration details, profile information, content of messages and photographs + usage and device data such as IP address and IP session information (CCPA Categories A, B, C, F, and H)" 

Because of this, not only do your verification images / videos need to be different, but your profile pictures need to be different too.

How to know if you have a "face ban"?

If you suspect one of your models has a face ban and want to take action to bypass that, some easily identifiable ways to know is if:

● You're consistently getting shadow banned upon account creation / after 24h ours
